embed.title: !area
embed.description: Choose which areas you get alerts from. Tracking rules without a `d:` distance only alert inside your selected areas. Areas belong to the profile you are on.

fields.name: See areas
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}area` — the areas you have selected
`{{prefix}}area list` — every area you can choose (🟢 = selected)
`{{prefix}}area show` — a map of each of your areas, or name some: `{{prefix}}area show north`
`{{prefix}}area show d500` — a map of a 500 m circle around your location
`{{prefix}}area overview` — all your areas on one map, or name some
Maps only appear if the server has a map service.

fields.name: Add and remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}area add north south` — add one or more areas
`{{prefix}}area north south` — same as `add`
`{{prefix}}area remove north` — remove one or more

Names are not case-sensitive. For a name with spaces, use underscores or quotes: `{{prefix}}area add north_london` or `{{prefix}}area add "north london"`. There is no remove-all: remove each area by name. Your admin may limit how many areas you can select.

fields.name: Areas or distance
fields.value:
A rule with `d:<metres>` alerts within that distance of your location and ignores your areas. A rule without `d:` uses your selected areas.
To limit one rule to particular areas, add `area:` to it: `{{prefix}}track pikachu area:north,south`.
